event_chain.summary: Staff send parishioner contact list to a scam email address

summary: On June 16, 2026 staff at the Catholic Cathedral Parish in Christchurch, New Zealand mistakenly sent the names and contact details of all parishioners to a scam email address. The parish tried to recall the message, asked recipients to delete it and notified the Privacy Commissioner, rating the risk as low to moderate. The Diocese warned that it was being targeted and urged people to check the sender before replying to messages purporting to come from priests.
